title: anikit public options
description: Every options object of the public anikit API, generated from the TypeScript types by packages/anikit/scripts/build-schema.mjs. Properties carry their JSDoc (`description`) and TypeScript type (`tsType`); functions are marked `x-function`. Unknown keys are reported at runtime with an "anikit:" warning.

anyOf.tsType: (target: any, index: number, count: number) => number

duration.description:
Length of one iteration, in **seconds** (not ms). Default `0.5`; with a
spring easing, the spring's natural settle time. Can be a function
`(target, index, count) => seconds`.

anyOf.tsType: (target: any, index: number, count: number) => number

delay.description: Wait before starting, in **seconds**. Use `stagger(0.05)` to offset each target.

endDelay.description: Seconds to hold after the last iteration before `finished` resolves. Default 0.

ease.description:
Easing. Default `'outQuad'`. Names (`'outCubic'`, `'power2.inOut'`, `'ease-in-out'`),
functions (`'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)'`, `'steps(4)'`, `'back.out(1.7)'`),
springs (`'spring(bounce: 0.3)'`, `{ stiffness: 200, damping: 20 }`), `[x1, y1, x2, y2]`
or `(t) => number`. An array gives one easing per keyframe segment.

repeat.description: Extra iterations after the first (`1` plays twice). `Infinity` or `-1` loops forever. Default 0.

repeatDelay.description: Pause between iterations, in seconds. Default 0.

yoyo.description: Alternate direction every iteration (same as `direction: 'alternate'`). Default false.

direction.description: Iteration direction, as in CSS. Default `'normal'`.

speed.description: Playback rate: `2` is twice as fast, negative plays backwards. Default 1.

autoplay.description: Start playing immediately. Default true; pass `false` for scroll triggers and manual control.

times.description: Keyframe offsets (0–1) for array values, e.g. `{ x: [0, 100, 50] }` with `times: [0, 0.3, 1]`.

colorSpace.description: Colour interpolation space. Default `'oklab'` (perceptually even, no grey midpoints).

fillMode.description: Which values apply outside the active period. Default `'both'`. (Named `fillMode` so `fill` stays the SVG property.)

overwrite.description: Take the animated properties over from animations already running on the same targets. Default true.

immediateRender.description: Render the first keyframe right away, before the delay ends. Default: on for delayed animations with explicit start values.

snap.description: Snap numeric values to a step (or the nearest of a list); a number applies to every property: `{ snap: { x: 50 } }`.

round.description: Round to integers: `true` for every property, or a list of property names.

modifiers.tsType: Record<string, (value: any, target: any) => any> | undefined
modifiers.description: Transform each value right before it is written, e.g. `{ x: (v) => v % 500 }` for wrapping.

format.description: Format numbers written as text (counters): `Intl.NumberFormat` options or a function.

locale.description: Locale used by `format`. Default: the user's.

anyOf.tsType: StaggerOptions & { each?: number | undefined; amount?: number | undefined; }

stagger.description:
Shorthand for `delay: stagger(each)` (GSAP style). The object form takes the
stagger options plus `each` / `amount`: `{ each: 0.05, from: 'center' }`.
stagger.tsType: number | (StaggerOptions & { each?: number | undefined; amount?: number | undefined; }) | undefined

onUpdate.description: Every frame while running, after the DOM writes of that frame.

onComplete.description: Reached the end (after the last repeat). The controller is also awaitable: `await anim`.

onRepeat.description: Each new iteration when `repeat` is set.

onReverseComplete.description: Reached the start while playing backwards (`reverse()` or negative speed).

anyOf.tsType: (target: unknown, index: number, count: number) => number

delay.description: Per-instance start delay in seconds: a number, `stagger(each)` or `(_, index, count) => seconds` (the first argument is always null).
delay.tsType: number | ((target: unknown, index: number, count: number) => number) | undefined

ease.description: Easing (default `'outQuad'`), or one per keyframe segment.

onUpdate.description: Every frame while running, after the DOM writes of that frame.

onComplete.description: Reached the end (after the last repeat). The controller is also awaitable: `await anim`.

onRepeat.description: Each new iteration when `repeat` is set.

onReverseComplete.description: Reached the start while playing backwards (`reverse()` or negative speed).

width.description: Output width in pixels (default: the canvas width, else 640).

height.description: Output height in pixels (default: the canvas height, else 400).

canvas.description: Canvas (or selector) to draw each frame into. Optional: `render()` always returns the pixels.

mode.description: 'physical': Doppler colour and g⁴ beaming (EHT / Luminet). 'cinematic': Interstellar-style, no Doppler colour, softened beaming. Default 'physical'.

scale.description: Internal resolution relative to `width`/`height` (default 1). The canvas is drawn at this size; CSS scales it up.

seed.description: Seed for the disk turbulence, stars and nebula (default 1).

budget.description:
Frame budget in ms (default 0 = off). When `render()` is consistently
slower — typically while the camera moves, which rebuilds the lensing
geometry — the internal scale steps down (to at most `minScale`), and
steps back up once frames are comfortably fast again.

minScale.description: Lowest scale the adaptive budget may use (default 0.5).

anyOf.tsType: (i: number, count: number) => number[] | [number, number, number]

shapes.description: Target shapes (index 0 is the starting shape).

spread.description: 0 = every particle moves at once; higher = a rippling transition (default 0.6).

background.description: Background painted before every frame (default none).

motionBlur.description: Motion blur: sub-frames per frame, or `{ samples, shutter }` (shutter 0…1, default 0.5 = 180°).
motionBlur.tsType: number | { samples: number; shutter?: number | undefined; } | undefined

bloom.description: Glow around bright pixels: strength (0–2), luminance threshold (0–1, default 0.7), radius px (default 24).

aberration.description: Radial chromatic aberration in px at the corners.

streaks.description: Anamorphic streaks: horizontal flares from highlights (strength 0–2), length px (default 160), tint (default cool blue).

zoomBlur.description:
Radial zoom blur (speed lines) towards `zoomCenter` ([0.5, 0.5] = middle):
0.1 fast, 0.3 warp. Usually a function of time: `zoomBlur: (t) => t > 3 && t < 4 ? 0.25 : 0`.

exposure.description: Colour grade: exposure (1 = none), contrast (1 = none), saturation (1 = none).

shadows.description: Split toning: colour added to shadows, and multiplied into highlights (0–1 each, e.g. teal shadows `[0, 0.04, 0.06]`, warm highlights `[0.08, 0.02, -0.04]`).

rays.description:
God rays: highlights streamed radially from `raysCenter` ([x, y] 0–1 of the frame,
e.g. a light behind the city) over `raysLength` (0–1, default 0.6) of the way. Strength 0–2.

aa.description: Edge antialiasing (FXAA-style) for 3D geometry, 0–1 (1 recommended with `renderer3d`).

flares.description:
Lens flares (0–2): ghosts of the bright lights mirrored through the frame centre
at several scales, tinted like lens coatings, plus a halo ring. Point a sun or a
hot light at the lens and the flares follow it.

post.description:
Film-look grade applied in WebAssembly to every finished frame: bloom
(`bloom`, `bloomThreshold`, `bloomRadius`), radial chromatic `aberration`
(px at the corners; impacts add to it), `vignette` and per-frame `grain`.

bounds.description: Keep within an element (by its box) or explicit limits (in transform px / degrees).

edgeResistance.description: Resistance past the bounds while dragging: 0 (hard stop) – 1 (no resistance). Default 0.35.

anyOf.tsType: { x?: SnapSpec | undefined; y?: SnapSpec | undefined; rotation?: SnapSpec | undefined; }

snap.description: Snap the resting position: number step, list or function — per axis via `{ x, y, rotation }`.
snap.tsType: SnapSpec | { x?: SnapSpec | undefined; y?: SnapSpec | undefined; rotation?: SnapSpec | undefined; } | undefined

handle.description: Only start dragging from this element (default: the target).

lockAxis.description: Lock to the dominant axis after a few pixels.

minimumMovement.description: Minimum movement (px) before a drag starts — lets clicks through. Default 3.

cursor.description: CSS cursor while hovering / dragging. Default `'grab'` / `'grabbing'`.

onPress.description: Pointer down on the target (before any movement).

onDrag.description: Every pointer move while dragging (`d.x`, `d.y`, `d.rotation` are current).

onDragEnd.description: Pointer released after a drag (before any inertia).

onRelease.description: Pointer released, whether or not it dragged.

onThrowUpdate.description: Every frame of the inertia glide.

onThrowComplete.description: The inertia glide came to rest.

size.description: Point radius in px at scale 1 (default 2).

anyOf.tsType: (i: number, depth: number, scale: number) => string

color.tsType: string | ((i: number, depth: number, scale: number) => string) | undefined

distance.description: Travel distance for slide/drop effects (px or any length).

chars.description: `scramble`: glyph set, `'upper' | 'lower' | 'digits' | 'symbols' | 'binary'` or your own characters.

rate.description: Particles per second (default 1000; 0 for bursts only).

life.description: Lifetime in seconds (default 2) and its ± variation fraction (default 0.3).

direction.description: Launch direction (default up), speed (default 200 units/s) and its variation.

spread.description: Cone half-angle in radians (default 0.4; Math.PI = every direction).

attractor.description: Pull toward (or, negative, push from) a point.

sizeStart.description: Size multiplier at birth and death (default 1 → 0).

colors.description: Colour over life: up to 4 CSS colours (birth → death).

lookAhead.description: Distance ahead along the path the camera looks at (world units, default 400).

maxBank.description: Maximum bank angle in degrees (default 55), approached smoothly rather than clipped.

bankWindow.description:
Distance over which the turn rate is averaged for banking (world units, default
`max(50, lookAhead)`). Longer = calmer, earlier banking through S-bends.

closed.description: Close the loop (last point joins the first).

scale.description: Animate size changes with scale (default true).

fade.description: Fade entering and leaving elements (shorthand for `enter: { opacity: [0, 1] }, leave: { opacity: 0 }`).

enter.description: Keyframes for elements that appear with the change.

leave.description: Keyframes for elements that disappear with the change (played at their last position before removal).

onEnter.description: Custom entrance: return an animation for the entering elements.

onLeave.description: Custom exit: return an animation; leaving elements are removed/hidden when it completes.

targets.description: Elements to consider after the change (default: the selector re-queried, or the captured elements).

id.description: Shared-element id of an element (default: its `data-flip-id` attribute).

crossfade.description: Cross-fade when both shared elements stay visible (default true).

correctRadius.description:
Keep `border-radius` undistorted while scaling, by counter-scaling it every
frame (default false: that's a style recalc and repaint per element per
frame, where transforms alone stay on the compositor).

onUpdate.description: Every frame while running, after the DOM writes of that frame.

onComplete.description: Reached the end (after the last repeat). The controller is also awaitable: `await anim`.

onRepeat.description: Each new iteration when `repeat` is set.

onReverseComplete.description: Reached the start while playing backwards (`reverse()` or negative speed).

apply.description: Write the transform to the element (default true); otherwise only report through callbacks.

minScale.description: Scale limits; past them the scale is rubber-banded and springs back on release.

bounds.description: Translation limits (`minX`, `maxX`, `minY`, `maxY`, in px), rubber-banded the same way.

edgeResistance.description: Pull past a limit: 0 = hard stop … 1 = no resistance (default 0.35).

inertia.description: Keep gliding after a fling (default true).

wheel.description: Trackpad pinch (Ctrl/⌘ + wheel) zooms about the pointer (default true).

wheelSpeed.description: Wheel zoom speed (default 0.01 per wheel pixel, exponential).

onStart.description: A gesture began (first pointer down / wheel).

onEnd.description: Fingers lifted (momentum or a spring back may follow).

resolution.description: Pixel buffer resolution relative to CSS pixels (default min(dpr, 1) * 0.75).

trail.description: Fraction of light kept between frames: 0 = no trails (default), 0.9 = long trails.

budget.description:
Frame budget in ms (default 7). When rendering is consistently slower,
the pixel resolution steps down (to at most `minResolution`) so slow
machines keep their frame rate. 0 disables.

minResolution.description: Lowest resolution adaptive quality may use (default 0.4).

mode.description:
`'light'` (default) adds light over the background; `'ink'` absorbs it,
like pigment on paper — use it on light backgrounds. Point colours are
then absorption per channel (`[1, 1, 1]` = black ink). Can be changed live.

fog.description: Depth fade `[near, far]` measured from the camera.

lens.description: Push points away from a screen point (CSS px) — e.g. the pointer.
lens.tsType: { x: number; y: number; radius?: number | undefined; strength?: number | undefined; } | null | undefined

maxRadius.description: Largest bokeh radius in buffer pixels (default 6).

tint.description: Multiply every point's colour (cheap live palette changes).

ImpactOptions.description: A hit: camera shake, a flash frame and an aberration kick, all decaying.

flash.description: Flash colour (default none) and peak opacity (default 0.85).

aberration.description: Extra chromatic aberration in px at the hit (default 0).

decay.description: Decay rate per second (default 10; higher = shorter).

shockwave.description:
A shockwave: a refracting ring that expands from `origin` (0–1 of the frame,
default centre) at `shockSpeed` frame diagonals per second (default 1.1),
displacing the picture by up to `shockwave` px (try 20–40) as it passes.

root.description: Scrolling ancestor used as the viewport. Default: the browser viewport.

power.description: Multiplier on how far momentum carries (default 0.8).

bounceStiffness.description: Spring used when hitting a bound.

stiffness.description: Spring constant. Default 100; higher is snappier (pointer followers: ~300).

damping.description: Friction. Default 10; higher settles with less overshoot (critically damped ≈ 2·√(stiffness·mass)).

duration.description: Perceptual alternative to stiffness/damping: approximate settle time in seconds (not ms)…

bounce.description: …and bounciness, 0 (none) to 1 (very bouncy). Default 0.25 when either is given.

velocity.description: Initial velocity (units/s); a number or per-property map. Defaults to the current velocity.

restDelta.description: Distance from target considered at rest.

onComplete.description: Came to rest (the controller is also awaitable: `await spring(…)`).

fog.description: Fog from `[near, far]` distance to `fogColor` (default: the background).

strips.description: Colour of sharp studio light strips in the environment: gives chrome crisp highlights.

groundFog.description: Ground fog in `fogColor`: full below `bottom`, none above `top` (world y), reaching full strength over `range` units of distance.
groundFog.tsType: { bottom: number; top: number; range: number; } | undefined

items.tsType: { position: V3; color?: string | V3 | undefined; radius?: number | undefined; intensity?: number | undefined; }

lights.description:
Point lights (up to 8): coloured pools of light from neon signs, trails, sparks.
`radius` sets the falloff (r² / (r² + d²), faded out by 4·radius), `intensity` its strength.
lights.tsType: { position: V3; color?: string | V3 | undefined; radius?: number | undefined; intensity?: number | undefined; }[] | undefined

strength.description: How far the element follows the pointer, as a fraction of the pointer's offset (default 0.3).

radius.description: Distance in px from the element's edge within which it reacts (default 80).

stiffness.description: Spring constant. Default 100; higher is snappier (pointer followers: ~300).

damping.description: Friction. Default 10; higher settles with less overshoot (critically damped ≈ 2·√(stiffness·mass)).

duration.description: Perceptual alternative to stiffness/damping: approximate settle time in seconds (not ms)…

bounce.description: …and bounciness, 0 (none) to 1 (very bouncy). Default 0.25 when either is given.

velocity.description: Initial velocity (units/s); a number or per-property map. Defaults to the current velocity.

restDelta.description: Distance from target considered at rest.

onComplete.description: Came to rest (the controller is also awaitable: `await spring(…)`).

spring.description: Spring for following and returning (default `{ stiffness: 220, damping: 16 }`).

axis.description: `'x'` (default, moves left for positive speed) or `'y'` (moves up).

gap.description: Space between items and between repeats, px (default 0: use CSS `gap` on the container instead).

pauseOnHover.description: Slow to a stop while the pointer is over it (default false).

hoverSpeed.description: Speed multiplier while hovered when not pausing (default 1).

scrollBoost.description:
Speed up with page scrolling: speed × (1 + scrollBoost × px/s of scroll / 1000),
following the scroll direction (default 0 = off).

smoothing.description: Seconds to ease between speeds (hover, scroll, `m.speed = …`; default 0.4).

emissive.description: Unlit self-illumination (×base colour): glows under the film grade's bloom.

metal.description: Chrome: mirror reflection of the sky/horizon/ground environment (0–1).

iridescence.description: Thin-film rainbow sheen by viewing angle (0–1; tints reflections), and its hue offset.

lines.description:
Glowing grid lines in the mesh's UV space (antialiased): intensity, colour,
cells along `[u, v]` (0 = no lines that way; u runs along tubes/knots, v around them; each cube face is 0–1),
and half-width in cells. Pair with a dark body and the film grade's bloom.

pattern.description: What `lines` draws: `'grid'` (default), `'hex'` cells, `'dots'`, or `'circuit'` traces with pads — in `grid` cells.

pulse.description:
Light pulses travelling along u in `lineColor`: intensity, pulses per unit u,
and phase (animate it, e.g. `pulsePhase: t * 0.8`). `pulseDir` offsets each
instance's phase by `dot(position, pulseDir)`, so a pulse sweeps through a
field of instances as a wave.

texture.description:
An image from `texture()`, mapped by the mesh's UVs (× `textureRepeat`).
`'albedo'` (default) tints the lit colour; `'emissive'` adds it unlit ×
`textureGain` — screens, signs, holograms.

textureFilter.description:
Texture filtering. `'linear'` (default): one bilinear tap from the mip level that
matches the larger side of each pixel's footprint. `'aniso'`: anisotropic — the mip
follows the smaller side (up to 8× finer) and up to 4 taps are averaged along the
longer one, so ground and roads seen at grazing angles stay sharp instead of
blurring. Costs more per pixel where the footprint is stretched.

fog.description:
How much the render's `fog` / `groundFog` applies to this material (default 1;
0 = none): sky domes and backdrops painted with their own haze.

path.description: Path data, a CSS selector or an SVG shape element.

start.description: Progress along the path to travel from / to (0–1). Default 0 → 1.

end.description: Progress along the path to stop at (0–1). Default 1.

rotate.description: Rotate the target to follow the path tangent; a number adds an angle offset.

align.description:
Put the target exactly on the path as drawn on the page: the path's
coordinates (its SVG user space, viewBox and all) are mapped to the
target's. `true` uses the path element itself; pass an SVG element when
`path` is raw path data in that element's coordinates.

alignOrigin.description: Point of the target that sits on the path, as fractions of its box (default `[0.5, 0.5]` with `align`).

target.description: Element (or selector) to listen on. Default: the window.

tolerance.description: Minimum accumulated movement before firing directional callbacks. Default 10.

preventDefault.description: Prevent default browser handling (e.g. page scroll) for wheel/touch.

wheelSpeed.description: Multiplier on wheel deltas (default 1; negative inverts).

onUp.description: Intent to see what is above (wheel up, swipe down).

onDown.description: Intent to see what is below (wheel down, swipe up).

onLeft.description: Intent to see what is to the left.

onRight.description: Intent to see what is to the right.

onStop.description: Fires once input has been quiet for 150ms.

speed.description:
Speed relative to the page while the element crosses the viewport: 0 moves
with the page, −0.5 lags behind (background feel), 0.5 runs ahead (default −0.3).

smooth.description: Smoothing in seconds (default 0: locked to the scroll).

stiffness.description: Spring constant. Default 100; higher is snappier (pointer followers: ~300).

damping.description: Friction. Default 10; higher settles with less overshoot (critically damped ≈ 2·√(stiffness·mass)).

bounce.description: …and bounciness, 0 (none) to 1 (very bouncy). Default 0.25 when either is given.

velocity.description: Initial velocity (units/s); a number or per-property map. Defaults to the current velocity.

restDelta.description: Distance from target considered at rest.

onComplete.description: Came to rest (the controller is also awaitable: `await spring(…)`).

streaks.description: Anamorphic streaks: horizontal flares from highlights (strength 0–2), length px (default 160), tint (default cool blue).

Radial zoom blur (speed lines) towards `zoomCenter` ([0.5, 0.5] = middle):
0.1 fast, 0.3 warp. Usually a function of time: `zoomBlur: (t) => t > 3 && t < 4 ? 0.25 : 0`.

aa.description: Edge antialiasing (FXAA-style) for 3D geometry, 0–1 (1 recommended with `renderer3d`).

flares.description:
